messages:
john_customer: Hey team — seeing intermittent 401s in the Console UI when I open a chat. Error says 'Unauthorized' briefly then it works. Can you share quick steps to capture network + console so you can repro?

kate_support: Sorry you're hitting this — we can definitely investigate. Can you capture a HAR and the DevTools console logs? Quick checklist below (Chrome/Edge + Firefox). Please redact any full API keys before upload. If you see an x-request-id or x-rw-request-id on the failing request, copy that too.

kate_support: Chrome / Edge (recommended)
1) Open the Console UI and reproduce the issue.
2) Open DevTools (F12 or Ctrl+Shift+I) -> Network tab.
3) Check 'Preserve log' (top-left).
4) Click the filter dropdown and select 'XHR' or type `/v1/` to filter requests to our API.
5) Reproduce the error once more.
6) Right-click the requests list -> 'Save all as HAR with content'.
7) Switch to Console tab, right-click inside logs -> 'Save as..' (or copy the visible errors).
8) Attach both the .har and the console log to this thread or upload to the support ticket.

kate_support: Firefox
- DevTools -> Network -> Settings -> enable 'Persist Logs' -> reproduce -> right-click -> 'Save All As HAR'. Console -> right-click -> 'Save visible messages'.

kate_support: Extra items that help us triage (please include where possible):
- Exact local time (timezone) when you reproduced
- Your account/org ID shown in the Console (bottom-left)
- The request headers for the failing request (only include headers except Authorization). We mainly need any x-request-id or x-rw-request-id.
- A short sequence of steps to reproduce (e.g., Dashboard -> Chat -> Click 'New chat' -> type -> Send)

kate_support: If you prefer we can also collect a debug bundle — run this in the Console devtools while reproducing:
```
// copy-paste into DevTools Console and press enter
window.__REDWOOD_DEBUG_CAPTURE && window.__REDWOOD_DEBUG_CAPTURE()
```
This will prompt to download a zip containing logs, localStorage snapshot, and the network HAR. Only run this if you're comfortable; remove API keys before sharing.

kate_support: If you can't attach files here, upload to our secure intake at https://support.redwood.ai/upload and paste the upload token/filename here.

lina_eng: One more ask from eng: if the HAR includes a 401, click the request and copy the response body and the response headers (redact Authorization). The x-request-id header is the fastest path to find the server logs.

john_customer: Ok I'm doing the steps now. Reproduced at 2026-03-15 17:12:03 UTC, account ID: acct_42, region: us-west-2. I saved a file named john_chat_error_2026-03-15.har and a console file console_john_2026-03-15.txt. I also see a header x-request-id: 01G8A3Z9H0.

kate_support: Thanks — can you attach both files here or paste the upload token? Also please confirm you removed the API key from the HAR (search for 'Authorization').

john_customer: Uploaded to support link: upload_9a7b3f. I removed Authorization entries. Files: john_chat_error_2026-03-15.har, console_john_2026-03-15.txt. x-request-id is 01G8A3Z9H0.

debug-bot: Received debug bundle from john_customer (upload_9a7b3f). Ticket #SUP-3487 created and assigned to kate_support.

kate_support: Got it — escalating to eng with the request id and HAR. Lina, forwarding the ticket.

lina_eng: Thanks — I'll pull the logs with x-request-id 01G8A3Z9H0 and report back. If we need a screen recording I'll ask for that.

john_customer: Appreciate it, thanks for the quick help :thumbsup:
